flags.description: Nestlé has been the target of an international consumer boycott, ongoing since 1989, over marketing of infant formula in developing countries in ways that critics and independent audits say violate the WHO's International Code of Marketing of Breast-Milk Substitutes.

Nestlé set a science-based target to halve absolute greenhouse gas emissions by 2030 and reach net zero by 2050; by 2022 roughly 85% of Nestlé's global electricity consumption came from renewable sources.
